occurrences.raw_occurrenceRemarks: At first I heard the very distinct Koala calling. I then waited and observed the nearby trees to try and sight it. After waiting for 15 minutes with no luck I returned to the house to get my shoes, upon my return I saw the Koala on the ground moving along the bottom of the gully in a southerly direction. Due to poor access I was unable to follow to capture a picture. I work in Port Stephens Council within the Natural Areas team and am very familiar with Koala's and their calls. I am positive with my ID.
